sections.advice: Treat High point near Queenstown → Near Queenstown as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch near Queenstown → Photo stop near Queenstown is the reward section in Queenstown. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near Cromwell, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Queenstown → Near Cromwell, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near Cromwell, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Cromwell → Back to Catlins Coastal is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Crown Range Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 83 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Wachau Danube Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Wachau Danube Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Ybbs - Kleinkastell → Wallsee - Kleinkastell
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-blashausgraben-wachtturm-historic.story: A 391 km round trip from Aggsbach - roughly 6 h 44 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ybbs - Kleinkastell, Wallsee - Kleinkastell, Linz - Befestigung Schlossberg and Historic Centre of Český Krumlov. It crosses from Austria into Czechia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
